# dsh-local-studio

Local creation studio for DeepSeek Harness:
a sidebar panel that turns **ComfyUI** into a text-to-im

age button and **GPT-SoVITS** into a
text-to-speech button, and keeps every generated file in a loca

text-to-speech button, and keeps every generated file in a local folder.

## Features

- **Sidebar entry + full-screen panel** — React rendered directly (no iframe), dark/light aware
(use

s DSH theme tokens), `Esc` closes it.
- **Health dots** — ComfyUI and GPT-SoVITS are probed with a 3

s timeout; hover a dot to see
the exact failure (`connection refused`, `timeout`, …) and the fix.
-

**Image tab** — prompt / width / height / steps → ComfyUI `/prompt` → poll `/history/{id}` →
downlo

ad `/view` → save `outputs/local-studio/image-<timestamp>.png`, preview in the panel.
- **Speech tab

** — text (+ optional reference audio) → GPT-SoVITS `/tts` (GET, then POST as a
fallback) → save `vo

ice-<timestamp>.wav`, listen directly in the panel.
- **Recent outputs tab** — the 30 newest images/

audio files in the output directory, with
thumbnail / audio preview and copy-path.
- **Friendly erro

rs everywhere** — every route returns `{ "error": "...", "hint": "..." }` with a
4xx/5xx status; a s
topped ComfyUI or a bad checkpoint name never crashes the host.
## Requirements
| Component | Version | Notes |

| DeepSeek Harness | `>= 0.2.2-rc.1 < 0.3.0-0` | uses the `connection` Fetch-route service |
| Node.

js | `>= 20` | DSH runtime already satisfies this |
| ComfyUI | optional | default `http://127.0.0.1

:8188` |
| GPT-SoVITS | optional | its `api.py` server, default `http://127.0.0.1:9880` |

Both services are optional: without them the panel still opens and tells you what to start.
The defa

ult ComfyUI workflow uses **Animagine XL 3.1** (`animagine-xl-3.1.safetensors`); any
SDXL checkpoint
works if you set `comfyCheckpoint` or supply your own workflow.

For local development you can link the directory instead (see `ai-brain/dsh-plugin/install.mjs`
for

the link-based recipe): copy this folder into `<profile>/local-plugins/dsh-local-studio`,
add `link:

./local-plugins/dsh-local-studio` to the profile `dependencies`, append
`dsh-local-studio` to `dsh.p
rofile.bundles`, run `pnpm install`, then restart DSH.
After a restart the sidebar footer shows **🎨 Local Studio**; open it from there.
## Configuration

`~/.dsh/local-studio.config.json` is optional — when it is missing, these defaults are used and
**no

o.config.json` is optional — when it is missing, these defaults are used and
**no file is created**:

| Key | Meaning |

| `comfyUrl` | ComfyUI root URL. Set to `""` to disable the image route (it answers 501). |
| `comfy
Checkpoint` | `ckpt_name` for `CheckpointLoaderSimple` — must match a file under `ComfyUI/models/che

ckpoints`. |
| `comfyWorkflow` | Optional absolute path to a ComfyUI **API-format** workflow JSON. S

upports the placeholders below. |
| `ttsUrl` | GPT-SoVITS root URL. Set to `""` to disable the speec

h route (it answers 501). |
| `ttsRefAudio` | Optional default reference audio path for GPT-SoVITS.

|
| `ttsPromptText` / `ttsPromptLang` | Optional `prompt_text` / `prompt_lang` for the reference aud

io. |
| `outputDir` | Output folder. Empty = `<workspace>/outputs/local-studio`. |
Environment overrides (used by the tests and handy for debugging):

- `DSH_LOCAL_STUDIO_CONFIG` — path to the config file
- `DSH_LOCAL_STUDIO_OUTPUT` — override `output

Dir`
- `DSH_WORKSPACE` — override workspace detection

The built-in workflow (also shipped as `app/workflow.json`) supports these placeholders:
`{{PROMPT}}

`, `{{NEGATIVE}}`, `{{WIDTH}}`, `{{HEIGHT}}`, `{{STEPS}}`, `{{SEED}}`,
`{{CHECKPOINT}}`. A custom wo
rkflow may use them or hard-code everything.
## HTTP API

All routes live on the authenticated shared `/api` channel of DSH (`connection.fetch.register`),
so

the Host/Origin fence and login state are enforced before the handler runs. Every response is
JSON e
xcept `/file`; failures are `{ "error": "...", "hint": "..." }` plus a 4xx/5xx status.
### `GET /api/dsh-local-studio/health`

Both probes time out after 3 s.
### `POST /api/dsh-local-studio/image`

Request: `{ "prompt": "1girl, cherry blossoms", "width": 1024, "height": 1024, "steps": 28 }`
(`widt
h`/`height` must be multiples of 8, 256–2048; `steps` 1–80; `seed` optional).
Response: `{ "file": "C:\\…\\image-20261108-135732.png", "name": "image-20261108-135732.png", "width

Flow: `POST /prompt` → poll `GET /history/{prompt_id}` every 1 s for up to 90 s → download
`GET /vie
w` → save the PNG into `outputDir`.
### `POST /api/dsh-local-studio/tts`

Request: `{ "text": "你好，世界", "refAudio": "D:\\voices\\ref.wav" }` (`refAudio` optional;
`text` ≤ 200

`{ "text": "你好，世界", "refAudio": "D:\\voices\\ref.wav" }` (`refAudio` optional;
`text` ≤ 2000 chars).
Response: `{ "file": "…/voice-20261108-135800.wav", "name": "…", "bytes": 123456, "mediaType": "audi
o/wav", "chars": 6, "ms": 1830, "mode": "GET" }`

Calls `GET {ttsUrl}/tts?text=…&text_language=zh&text_lang=zh&media_type=wav…`; if that endpoint is
n

ot accepted (404/405/422) it retries with `POST {ttsUrl}/tts` and a JSON body. When `ttsUrl` is
expl
icitly empty the route answers **501** with a configuration hint.
## Known limitations

- One image per request; batch/queue management is left to ComfyUI.
- The built-in workflow is a sin

gle SDXL text-to-image graph; use `comfyWorkflow` for anything
else (LoRA, ControlNet, upscale, vide

o…).
- Prompt length capped at 2000 characters, speech text at 2000 characters.
- The image route wa

its synchronously for up to 90 s; the panel shows a live timer.
- Windows-first development (output
paths are shown as returned by the host).
